title: CiteTrace queries
description: One row per Stack Exchange query. Mirrors the queries.parquet column set on Hugging Face.

site.description: Stack Exchange site official name (28 sites). e.g. 'Stack Overflow', 'Medical Sciences'

question_title.description: Stack Exchange post title. Per Appendix B.1 quality filter: 15<=len<=150.

question_url.description: Permanent URL of the original Stack Exchange post.

QI_label.description: Query Intent label (Appendix C.1.1). Nullable when emitted by the sampler before LLM intent classification.
